summary.headline: Trines and Sextiles of Saturn and Venus
summary.text: Astrological delineations of trines and sextiles involving the Sun, Saturn, and Venus, predicting political favor, peace, agriculture, weather, food, fortresses, and social prosperity. The passage specifies effects of Saturn in the tenth house or an angle and of planets in cold, watery, or earthy signs.
